text: Android: dialogs and popups ignored the chosen UI language

Fixed and shipped in 1.9.2.

Scope was wider than reported: all seven AlertDialogs and the full-screen
edit-item Dialog were affected, not just the join dialog — it was simply the
first dialog opened with the app in German.

Verified in the built APK with aapt2: redeem_title resolves to "Liste beitreten"
(de) and the equivalents in all nine locales, and the three newly-extracted
strings (action_add, listprops_invite_pending,
settings_collaborator_changes_help) are present across all nine too.
